title: Juneteenth.
bodyText: June 19 of each year shall be known and designated as Juneteenth to commemorate the end of slavery in the United States and in honor and recognition of the significant roles and contributions of African Americans in the history of the United States. Juneteenth is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday.
bodyHtml: [§8-32]  Juneteenth.  June 19 of each year shall be known and designated as Juneteenth to commemorate the end of slavery in the United States and in honor and recognition of the significant roles and contributions of African Americans in the history of the United States.  Juneteenth is not and shall not be construed to be a state holiday. [L 2021, c 53, §2]
